gates.name: Check no runtime dependencies
gates.command: node --input-type=module -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; const p = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json', 'utf8')); if (Object.keys(p.dependencies ?? {}).length) throw new Error('Runtime dependencies are forbidden');"

gates.name: Check commits carry no AI attribution
Run offline Pester suite
gates.command: Invoke-Pester -Path tools -Output Detailed -PassThru (without GH_TOKEN or gh credentials)

gates.name: Lint videos/
gates.command: cd videos; npx @biomejs/biome lint segments components styles videos videowright.config.ts scripts
